papers.title: VibeVideoBench:Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
papers.abstract: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a ruleconsistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events. A different route is emerging: multimodal agents that write code to render every frame and synthesize every sound. We introduce VibeVideoBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on code-driven video generation. Its 239 self-contained tasks in English and Chinese span 12 categories, from data stories and music-driven pieces to classroom lessons and paper explainers; each asks an agent, running in its native harness inside a sandbox, to deliver a finished MP4 with sound within one hour. Evaluation is hierarchical and evidence-based: program checks of the delivery spec, about 13k task-specific rubric checks traced to the requirements they enforce, and five quality dimensions anchored per task, judged by three VLM judge panels and validated with blind human preferences. Across nine frontier agent systems and 2,151 scored rollouts, the benchmark is far from solved: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead clearly, yet even the best system fails a core requirement on about a quarter of tasks. Whether a video arrives at all matters as much as its quality, and three quarters of the lost videos are final renders started too late, run too slowly or never started. The judges agree with each other and with human preferences on system rankings, but only moderately on individual videos.

ai_summary.problem: 扩散视频模型难以精确呈现公式、图表、规则一致的游戏或与画面同步的旁白，因此需要评估能够通过编写代码逐帧渲染视频并合成声音的多模态智能体。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 VibeVideoBench，包含 239 个中英文自包含任务、覆盖 12 类场景，要求智能体在沙箱原生环境中于一小时内交付带声音的 MP4。评测采用分层、证据驱动方式：程序检查交付规范、约 1.3 万条可追溯到任务需求的具体评分项，以及由三个 VLM 评审面板按五个质量维度评分，并用盲测人类偏好验证。
ai_summary.result: 在九个前沿智能体系统和 2151 次评分运行中，基准仍远未解决：GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5.5 明显领先，但最佳系统仍在约四分之一任务上失败核心要求；视频能否成功交付与质量同样重要，四分之三的丢失视频源于最终渲染启动过晚、运行过慢或从未启动。评审间及与人类偏好在系统排名上较一致，但对单个视频仅中等一致。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出了面向代码驱动视频生成的多模态智能体基准，并结合可追溯评分项、VLM 评审面板与人类偏好验证进行分层评测。
ai_summary.relevance: 为评估多模态智能体在长程代码生成、执行调度与视频交付可靠性方面提供了新基准，揭示了当前前沿系统在真实端到端创作任务中的关键瓶颈。

papers.title: MedVTok: A General-Purpose Medical Visual Tokenizer
papers.abstract: Multimodal medical AI requires a common visual interface for encoding heterogeneous imaging evidence for patient condition modeling. However, existing medical visual tokenizers are often tied to a specific dimension and imaging modality, forcing multimodal systems to rely on fragmented and poorly reusable representations. We introduce MedVTok, a general-purpose visual tokenizer that maps 2D images and 3D volumes from diverse imaging modalities into a unified token space. Building such a tokenizer poses two key challenges: preserving anatomical structure across dimensions and capturing clinical semantics across modalities. To this end, MedVTok introduces (i) slice differential regularization, which explicitly models inter-slice anatomical coherence missing in previous per-pixel/per-voxel supervision, and (ii) multi-expert representation alignment, which integrates knowledge from multiple medical expert encoders while retaining modality-specific complementary knowledge. Trained on 28M images and 70K volumes across 9 imaging modalities, MedVTok supports classification, retrieval, segmentation, synthesis, visual question answering, and medical report generation through a single tokenizer. Across 24 benchmarks, MedVTok achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating a scalable token interface that unifies medical image dimension, modality, and task usage.

ai_summary.problem: 现有医学视觉 tokenizer 通常绑定特定维度（2D/3D）和成像模态，导致多模态医疗系统只能使用碎片化、难以复用的表示，缺乏统一的视觉接口。
ai_summary.method: 提出 MedVTok，将多种模态的 2D 图像与 3D 体数据映射到统一 token 空间；通过切片差分正则化显式建模层间解剖连贯性，并用多专家表示对齐融合多个医学专家编码器的知识，同时保留模态特有的互补信息。
ai_summary.result: 在 28M 图像、70K 体数据、9 种模态上训练，单一 tokenizer 支持分类、检索、分割、合成、VQA 和报告生成；在 24 个基准上取得 SOTA。
ai_summary.novelty: 首个跨维度、跨模态、跨任务的通用医学视觉 tokenizer，并用切片差分正则化与多专家对齐解决结构与语义的统一编码难题。
ai_summary.relevance: 为医疗多模态大模型提供了可扩展的统一视觉 token 接口，有望推动医学 AI 从碎片化专用模型走向通用基础模型。

papers.title: Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent
papers.abstract: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without any real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. We demonstrate that ZAP also generalizes to completely new objects, goals, strategies, and language by seating a test tube in a rack (and choosing a different hole in the rack when prompted), handing a test tube between arms mid-air, drawing an X on a tic-tac-toe board, and playing chess. These goals and types of manipulation don't appear in our training data. Furthermore, ZAP also transfers to an unseen embodiment. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人策略既要理解场景中任务“要做什么”，又要知道“如何移动”去完成它；论文希望在完全不使用真实机器人训练数据的前提下，同时获得这两种能力并实现组合泛化。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP)：用一个现成的 27B 预训练视觉语言模型通过简单的工具接口（tool harness）控制机器人，先借助预训练模型的世界理解与推理能力，再在简单仿真任务上做监督微调和 GRPO 强化学习来教会它“怎么动”。训练全程不使用真实机器人数据。
ai_summary.result: 在真实世界任务上达到 96.7% 成功率，与 GPT-6 Astra 持平，远超 MolmoAct2 VLA（33.3%），且速度快 3 倍、成本低 17 倍；还能泛化到训练中未出现的物体、目标、策略与语言指令（试管入架并换孔、双臂空中交接、井字棋画 X、下棋），并迁移到未见过的单臂 Franka 本体，在 RoboLab-120 上达 55.9%，领先最强 VLA/WAM 基线 4.9 个百分点。
ai_summary.novelty: 将“语义理解”交给预训练 VLM、“动作技能”交给仿真 RL 微调，通过工具接口解耦二者，实现零真实机器人数据下的强组合泛化与跨本体迁移。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明小型仿真训练 VLM Agent 可在真实机器人任务上媲美超大通用模型且成本低一个量级，为具身智能的“仿真训练+预训练知识”路线提供了有力证据。

papers.title: Adapt for Planning, Not just Prediction: Optimistic Test-Time World Model Adaptation
papers.abstract: Latent world models are typically pre-trained offline and kept frozen at test time, so planning with them can degrade under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this degradation by updating the model during deployment. Unlike pre-training on fixed data, TTA for planning is closed-loop: the planner uses model rollouts to select actions, and the resulting transitions drive the next update. This raises the question: which objective should guide TTA for planning? Under a prediction-only objective, the model is fit only to the outcomes of its own actions, so it can remain wrong about the actions that would reach the goal, and low prediction error need not translate into better planning. Inspired by reward-biased maximum likelihood from adaptive control, we introduce Optimistic Test-Time Adaptation (OpTTA). Its objective has two terms, the prediction loss on observed transitions and the planner's goal-reaching cost on its candidate rollouts, both minimized over the model parameters. The planning term biases adaptation toward models that are optimistic about reaching the goal, without any additional environment interaction. Across visual and environment shifts on manipulation, reaching and navigation tasks, OpTTA raises final planning success over the frozen model by 13.5 percentage points on average, compared with 6.9 for the prediction-only objective (AdaJEPA), when only the predictor is adapted. When the encoder is adapted as well, the gains are 13.5 and 7.5 points. These experiments span three JEPA world models with different encoders and training objectives and, for temporal straightening, both CEM and gradient-based planners. Our results suggest that test-time adaptation of world models for planning benefits from an optimistic, task-aware term in addition to the prediction loss.

ai_summary.problem: 潜在世界模型通常在离线预训练后于测试时保持冻结，在分布偏移下会导致规划性能下降；论文研究面向规划的测试时适应应采用什么目标。
ai_summary.method: 提出乐观测试时适应（OpTTA），其目标由两部分组成：观测转移上的预测损失，以及规划器在候选 rollout 上的目标到达代价，二者共同对模型参数最小化；该规划项使适应偏向对达成目标更乐观的模型，且无需额外环境交互。
ai_summary.result: 在操作、到达和导航任务及视觉/环境偏移下，仅适应预测器时，OpTTA 相比冻结模型平均提升最终规划成功率 13.5 个百分点，而仅预测目标的 AdaJEPA 为 6.9；同时适应编码器时，增益分别为 13.5 和 7.5 个百分点。
ai_summary.novelty: 将规划器的目标到达代价作为乐观任务感知项加入世界模型测试时适应目标，而不仅依赖预测损失。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明世界模型用于规划时，测试时适应应引入任务感知的乐观目标，而不仅是降低预测误差。

papers.title: EEGaze: Multimodal Attention Prediction in Visual Search via EEG-Based Saliency Refinement
papers.abstract: Visual search is ubiquitous in daily life, from locating keys in a messy apartment to finding a tool in a cluttered workshop or an application icon on a desktop screen. While visual attention is to a large extent driven by image content, research in psychology indicates that user cognitive states have a significant influence on attention allocation. A promising way to access information about cognitive states is via Electroencephalography (EEG) recordings. Despite this potential, previous works in computational attention modeling have largely disregarded EEG, and related studies in psychology operate with abstract, simplistic stimuli, or even artificially guided search procedures. We bridge this gap with two contributions. First, we present EEGaze 140, the largest publicly available multimodal dataset of free visual search with realistic stimuli. The dataset contains synchronized EEG and eye tracking recordings from 36 participants across 140 naturalistic scenes, covering two scenarios: searching for desktop icons and finding tools in cluttered workshop scenes. Second, we introduce EEGazeNet, the first method for human attention prediction in visual search that integrates EEG signals. Our approach consists of a EEG guided refinement stage that adapts the output of a state of the art saliency prediction method to the user current cognitive state. In comprehensive evaluations on EEGaze 140, we show that EEGazeNet consistently outperforms all baselines and ablation conditions.

ai_summary.problem: 现有计算注意力模型大多忽略EEG所反映的用户认知状态，且相关心理学研究多使用抽象刺激或人工引导搜索，缺乏真实场景下自由视觉搜索的多模态数据与建模方法。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建了EEGaze 140数据集，包含36名参与者在140个自然场景中进行自由视觉搜索的同步EEG与眼动记录，覆盖桌面图标搜索和杂乱车间工具搜索两类场景；并提出EEGazeNet，通过EEG引导的细化阶段，将先进显著性预测模型的输出适配到用户当前认知状态。
ai_summary.result: 在EEGaze 140上的综合评估表明，EEGazeNet持续优于所有基线方法和消融条件。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出了目前最大的公开真实刺激自由视觉搜索多模态EEG-眼动数据集，并首次将EEG信号融入视觉搜索中的人类注意力预测方法。
ai_summary.relevance: 为认知状态感知的多模态注意力建模、EEG与视觉融合以及人机交互中的个性化注意力预测提供了数据与方法基础。

papers.title: SeeRF: Learning to See Beyond Fields of View via Generative Image Registration and Fusion
papers.abstract: Due to the inherent discrepancies in imaging viewpoints and field-of-view mismatches among multi-modal sensors, existing fusion methods have long struggled to achieve complete scene-level information integration beyond the limitation in sensor fields of view. Consequently, the generated fusion results often contain modality-specific regions and fusion artifacts, limiting the comprehensive representation of scene structures and semantic information. To address this challenge, we propose a generative registration-fusion framework, termed SeeRF. Specifically, it first introduces a deformation generation strategy based on the diffeomorphic stationary velocity field, combined with visual foundation model-guided feature extraction and a coarse-to-fine progressive multi-modal image registration module, to achieve accurate cross-modal flow estimation and generate valid field-of-view masks. Subsequently, the registration module is tightly coupled with the generative diffusion module for multi-modal completion and fusion, where the cross-modal control encoding module and the control residual feature encoder-decoder mechanism provide effective guidance. By leveraging the powerful prior modeling capability of generative diffusion models, the proposed framework overcomes the limitations imposed by shared fields of view and enables effective completion and natural fusion of non-overlapping field-of-view regions. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets and real-world scenarios demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance, validating its effectiveness, superiority, and robustness. The code will be available at https://github.com/XunpengYi/SeeRF.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态传感器存在视角差异和视场不匹配，现有融合方法难以实现超出传感器视场的完整场景级信息整合，导致融合结果包含模态特定区域和伪影。
ai_summary.method: 提出SeeRF生成式配准-融合框架：先用基于微分同胚平稳速度场的形变生成策略、视觉基础模型引导的特征提取和由粗到细的渐进式多模态配准模块，实现跨模态光流估计并生成有效视场掩码；再将配准模块与生成式扩散模块紧密耦合，通过跨模态控制编码和控制残差特征编解码机制引导多模态补全与融合。
ai_summary.result: 在多个公开数据集和真实场景上的实验表明，该方法能有效补全非重叠视场区域并实现自然融合，性能优于现有方法，验证了其有效性、优越性和鲁棒性。
ai_summary.novelty: 将跨模态图像配准与生成式扩散模型紧耦合，利用生成先验突破共享视场限制，实现非重叠视场区域的多模态补全与融合。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态感知中的视场不匹配问题提供了生成式配准融合新思路，有望提升自动驾驶、机器人和具身智能等场景的全景场景理解能力。

papers.title: Context-Aware Generation and Modulation of Expressive Motion Behavior using Multimodal Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Expressive robot motion positively impacts human-robot interaction by improving user engagement, likability, or task performance. We present a novel approach to automatically generate and modulate complex, expressive full-body gesture sequences from a multimodal (text, audio, video) context description. Based on a unified mathematical implementation of the Principles of Animation using Dynamic Movement Primitives, we use multimodal foundation models to generate such sequences along with parametric motion variations that are highly context-aware. This method extends the state of the art in terms of flexibility and generality by being interpretable, composable, and working across different robot morphologies. Moreover, we integrate the system into a continuous control framework and leverage knowledge distillation to learn a much smaller model, significantly improving token efficiency and system latency. Results from a user study with a human-like platform indicate that participants judged our system's motions to be better aligned with the interaction context than motions produced under a non-modulated or API-level condition. We also demonstrate how the system generates expressive motion for robots with different kinematics, showcasing its versatility. Paper webpage: https://gen-mod-expressive-motion-behavior.github.io/.

ai_summary.problem: 如何从多模态上下文自动生成并调制机器人富有表现力的全身动作，同时保持跨机器人形态、可解释性和低延迟。
ai_summary.method: 基于动态运动基元（DMP）统一实现动画原则，利用多模态基础模型生成动作序列及其参数化变化；再将系统集成到连续控制框架，并通过知识蒸馏学习更小模型以提升 token 效率和降低延迟。
ai_summary.result: 用户研究表明，系统生成的动作比非调制或 API 级条件更贴合交互上下文；同时可跨不同运动学机器人生成富有表现力的动作。
ai_summary.novelty: 将动画原则的 DMP 参数化与多模态基础模型结合，实现可解释、可组合、跨形态的上下文感知动作生成与调制。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动多模态基础模型在人形/机器人具身智能与人机交互中生成可控、低延迟且符合情境的表达性动作。
ai_summary.org: University of Freiburg（弗莱堡大学）

papers.title: WorldPager: Zero-Stall Tiered Memory for Long-Horizon World Models on a Single Consumer GPU
papers.abstract: Interactive world models keep the KV of past chunks as retrieval memory so that revisited places stay consistent. On a single consumer machine (one RTX 4090, 32 GiB of host memory, one NVMe SSD), long sessions with such memory hit two walls. The first is capacity: the KV of Matrix-Game 2.0 exhausts host memory after 45 seconds of video in bf16 and after 2.8 minutes in int4. The second is the model's positional horizon of 4.3 minutes. We show that this memory is capacity-bound rather than bandwidth-bound and that its access set is known before compute, because the camera pose is an input. An analytical model built on these observations predicts spill points to within one chunk and classifies zero versus non-zero stalls correctly on held-out configurations. Guided by it, WorldPager stores int4 KV in a GPU/DRAM/NVMe hierarchy instead of recomputing it, prefetches each chunk's memory from the extrapolated pose, never waits on a miss, and writes back in the background; to our knowledge, it is the first to place the KV memory of an interactive world model on an NVMe tier with zero-stall prefetching. With training-free position handling, it generates 37.5 minutes of video continuously with zero stalls and constant host memory, at about 9.5 frames per second. On a sealed test set, int4 storage shows no measurable quality loss; on long-gap revisits it lowers image quality by about one MUSIQ point.

ai_summary.problem: 在单台消费级机器上运行交互式世界模型时，历史 KV 作为检索记忆会迅速耗尽主机内存，并受模型位置窗口限制，导致长时程视频生成出现容量瓶颈和停顿。
ai_summary.method: 论文先建立解析模型，证明该记忆是容量受限而非带宽受限，且访问集可由输入相机位姿预知；据此提出 WorldPager，将 int4 KV 分层存储在 GPU/DRAM/NVMe 中，基于外推位姿预取、零等待缺失处理、后台写回，并用免训练位置处理扩展位置范围。
ai_summary.result: 在单张 RTX 4090、32 GiB 主机内存和 NVMe SSD 上连续生成 37.5 分钟视频，零停顿、主机内存恒定，约 9.5 FPS；密封测试集上 int4 存储无明显质量损失，长间隔重访时图像质量约下降 1 个 MUSIQ 点。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将交互式世界模型的 KV 记忆放到 NVMe 层级，并结合解析模型实现零停顿预取。
ai_summary.relevance: 为在消费级硬件上部署长时程、可交互世界模型提供了可行的记忆分层与预取系统方案。

papers.title: Generative Structure from Motion with Native 3D Diffusion
papers.abstract: Recovering an object's 3D structure and camera motion from a few uncalibrated views is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Classical structure from motion methods recover 3D geometry consistent with the input images but cannot recover unseen regions; native generation methods produce plausible 3D objects which are related but not necessarily faithful to the input images. Methods simply concatenating reconstruction and generation allow error to cascade across the two stages, instead of producing a 3D object consistent with both the distribution and the input. We propose GenSfM, which integrates image-based 3D reconstruction with a native 3D diffusion model. In particular, we use a multi-modal diffusion transformer to jointly denoise the shape latent and per-view pose latents under shared self-attention, grounding generated geometry in the observed views while using object-level priors to infer unobserved regions. A compact 3D-native UV-volume tokenization keeps the joint sequence small as views are added, and a pose-aware stage refines geometry and texture by sampling per-voxel image features at the recovered camera poses. On Toys4k and GSO, for $4$ uncalibrated views, GenSfM improves novel-view PSNR by $3.2$-$4.5$ dB and reduces median Chamfer distance by $2.8$-$3.8\times$ over a strong native-3D generation baseline, while recovering input-view poses over $96\%$ Acc@$5^\circ$ without any external pose-estimation backbone, post-hoc optimization, or known intrinsics. Project page: https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/.

ai_summary.problem: 论文要解决的是从少量未标定视角图像中同时恢复物体三维结构与相机位姿的问题，即如何在只有少量输入视图时，既保证重建结果忠实于观测图像，又能合理推断不可见区域。
ai_summary.method: 提出 GenSfM，将基于图像的三维重建与原生 3D 扩散模型结合：用多模态扩散 Transformer，在共享自注意力下联合去噪形状隐变量与逐视角位姿隐变量，使生成几何既受观测视图约束，又利用物体级先验补全未观测区域。该方法还采用紧凑的 3D-native UV-volume 分词以控制联合序列长度，并用位姿感知精修阶段在恢复的相机位姿上采样逐体素图像特征，从而精修几何与纹理。
ai_summary.result: 在 Toys4k 和 GSO 数据集上，仅用 4 个未标定视角时，新视角 PSNR 相比强原生 3D 生成基线提升 3.2–4.5 dB，中位 Chamfer 距离降低 2.8–3.8 倍；同时输入视角位姿恢复达到 96% 以上的 Acc@5°，且无需外部位姿估计骨干、后处理优化或已知内参。
ai_summary.novelty: 创新点在于把 SfM 式位姿估计与原生 3D 扩散生成统一到共享自注意力的联合去噪框架中，实现重建与生成的单阶段耦合，避免两阶段拼接带来的误差级联。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作展示了生成式先验与几何重建融合的一条可行路径，对少视图三维重建、位姿估计与原生 3D 生成模型的实际落地具有参考价值。

papers.title: When Fine-Grained Credit Assignment Helps and Hurts: Multimodal Agentic Reinforcement Learning through Video Editing
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for training multimodal agents to reason and use tools. However, it remains unclear when fine-grained credit assignment improves learning and when it fails to improve task performance. Video editing provides a useful testbed for this question, combining multimodal perception, long-horizon planning, and tool use with delayed outcome feedback. We construct four movie-trailer editing task types---Content Selection, Narrative Sequencing, Rough Cut, and Fine Cut---that reflect real-world editing workflows and span different levels of task complexity and interaction horizon. Decaying process rewards provides the largest benefit on Fine Cut, with a 45.4% relative gain over outcome-only GRPO on tasks averaging more than 60 turns under outcome-only GRPO. On the three shorter-horizon task types averaging 30--40 turns under the same baseline, outcome-only GRPO remains competitive, with decaying process rewards yielding at most a 10.4% relative gain. Process rewards from an LLM judge initially improve tool use and encourage visual inspection. As training progresses, however, GRPO+PRM with a fixed process-reward weight increasingly exhibits excessive reasoning and redundant tool calls: process rewards continue to rise while task completion rates and outcome scores decline. Decaying the process-reward weight to zero mitigates this reward-hacking behavior while preserving the early gains. Despite dense token-level supervision, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) yields little improvement or substantial degradation and is highly sensitive to the choice of privileged information. Our analysis reveals differences in teacher--student disagreement and gradient magnitudes, and suggests possible dilution of informative signals over long trajectories.

ai_summary.problem: 论文研究在多模态智能体强化学习中，细粒度信用分配（过程奖励）何时能帮助学习、何时会失效甚至损害任务表现。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建了四类电影预告片剪辑任务（内容选择、叙事排序、粗剪、精剪），覆盖不同任务复杂度和交互长度，并比较多模态智能体在仅结果反馈的 GRPO、基于 LLM 评判的过程奖励、过程奖励衰减策略以及 on-policy self-distillation（OPSD）下的表现。
ai_summary.result: 过程奖励衰减在长程精剪任务上相对仅结果 GRPO 取得 45.4% 的最大相对提升；在较短程任务上仅结果 GRPO 仍有竞争力，过程奖励提升至多 10.4%。固定权重过程奖励会诱发过度推理和冗余工具调用等 reward hacking，衰减到零可缓解；OPSD 提升有限甚至显著退化，且对特权信息选择高度敏感。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过视频剪辑任务系统揭示了细粒度信用分配的收益随交互时长变化，并识别出固定过程奖励导致的奖励黑客行为及衰减策略的缓解作用。
ai_summary.relevance: 为长程多模态智能体强化学习中的信用分配、过程奖励设计和训练稳定性提供了重要的实证指导。

papers.title: TP-JSCC: Efficient Token Pruning and Joint Source-Channel Coding for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration
papers.abstract: Deploying large vision-language models (LVLMs) on resource-constrained embodied agents for 3D visual question answering necessitates cloud-edge collaboration. However, offloading massive visual data to the cloud over bandwidth-limited and noisy channels introduces severe latency and transmission distortion. To address this, we propose TP-JSCC, an efficient token pruning and joint source-channel coding method for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration. First, we develop a Local and Global Semantics-based Hybrid Token Pruning (LGS-HTP) module to significantly reduce the visual token count. By decoupling foreground-background tokens and jointly selecting local and global semantics, LGS-HTP effectively reduces redundancy while preserving reasoning-critical tokens. Second, we introduce a lightweight Token Joint Source-Channel Coding (T-JSCC) module to further compress the pruned tokens and ensure their robust transmission over error-prone channels. By employing lightweight cascaded linear layers and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)-adaptive mechanism, this module adapts to fluctuating channel conditions while maintaining minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on ScanQA and SQA3D datasets indicate the exceptional efficiency and robustness of our approach. Specifically, on ScanQA validation set, the LGS-HTP module could achieve 90% pruning ratio while incurring less than a 1% CIDEr loss. Building on this, the T-JSCC further compresses the tokens by 18 times, resulting in an overall 180 times data volume reduction for robust transmission, while saving 90% in computational complexity for LVLM deployment. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuanhui0325/TP-JSCC.

ai_summary.problem: 在资源受限的具身智能体上部署LVLM进行3D视觉问答时，需要在云边协同中传输大量视觉数据，面临带宽受限、信道噪声、延迟和传输失真等问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出TP-JSCC：先用基于局部与全局语义的混合Token剪枝模块LGS-HTP解耦前景/背景并联合选择局部与全局语义，显著减少视觉Token冗余；再用轻量级Token联合信源信道编码模块T-JSCC，通过级联线性层和SNR自适应机制压缩剪枝后Token并保障噪声信道下的稳健传输。
ai_summary.result: 在ScanQA和SQA3D上验证有效性；ScanQA验证集上LGS-HTP达到90%剪枝率且CIDEr损失低于1%，T-JSCC进一步将Token压缩18倍，总体数据量降低180倍，同时节省90%的LVLM部署计算复杂度。
ai_summary.novelty: 将局部-全局语义混合Token剪枝与SNR自适应的轻量级联合信源信道编码结合，用于云边协同LVLM 3D-VQA的高效稳健传输。
ai_summary.relevance: 为带宽受限和噪声无线信道下LVLM在具身智能体上的高效部署提供了实用方案，兼顾压缩率、鲁棒性与计算开销。
ai_summary.org: 元数据未提供作者单位；作者包括Sam Kwong，通常隶属香港城市大学，具体以论文为准。

papers.title: Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench: From Direct Control to Harness with Policy
papers.abstract: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can control robots without robot-specific training, but how their capabilities compare and interact with post-trained vision-language-action (VLA) and world action model (WAM) policies across manipulation demands remains to be thoroughly evaluated. In this report, we evaluate GPT-6-Astra on EBench as the core of an agent that controls a robot through an agent harness under the same visual and proprioceptive observation protocol as post-trained policies. We study two agent configurations: direct control, in which the agent generates waypoint commands directly, and harness with policy, in which it can also invoke a post-trained VLA or WAM policy for action execution. Under direct control, the agent achieves competitive overall performance relative to post-trained policies. It leads on short-horizon tasks and exhibits the least performance variation across generalization dimensions, whereas it underperforms post-trained policies on long-horizon tasks, tabletop manipulation, and high-precision contact-rich tasks. In the harness with policy, invoking a post-trained VLA or WAM combines the complementary strengths of both components, raising overall task success to the level of the strongest compared post-trained policies while substantially reducing token cost. However, performance remains below the per-task upper bound of the standalone components due to suboptimal policy invocation, fixed-instruction execution without subgoals, and grasp disruption when the agent resumes control. Overall, our study characterizes the capability boundary of a frontier MLLM agent and suggests directions for improving future agent harness design. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/

ai_summary.problem: 这篇论文要评估前沿多模态大模型智能体在机器人操作中的能力边界，以及它与经过后训练的VLA/WAM策略相比和结合时的表现。
ai_summary.method: 作者在EBench上以GPT-6-Astra为核心构建机器人智能体，在与后训练策略相同的视觉和本体感知观测协议下测试两种配置：直接生成路点命令的直接控制，以及可调用后训练VLA或WAM策略执行动作的harness with policy。
ai_summary.result: 直接控制整体表现可与后训练策略竞争，在短时程任务上领先且泛化波动最小，但在长时程、桌面操作和高精度接触丰富任务上较弱；结合策略调用后整体成功率提升至最强对比策略水平并显著降低token成本，但因策略调用不优、缺少子目标、恢复控制时抓取扰动等仍低于各组件逐任务上界。
ai_summary.novelty: 在统一基准和观测协议下系统刻画前沿MLLM智能体直接控制与混合调用后训练VLA/WAM策略的能力边界与互补性。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能中前沿大模型智能体的能力评估和未来agent harness设计提供了实证依据与改进方向。
ai_summary.org: 上海人工智能实验室（InternRobotics）

papers.title: From Self-Confidence to Statistical Accuracy: Scaling Human-in-the-Loop Evaluation with Direct and LLM-Assisted Auditing
papers.abstract: For large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs), model-reported self-confidence is often miscalibrated, yet it may still be useful for efficient evaluation. At the same time, LLM-as-a-judge offers a scalable alternative to direct human auditing, but its practical benefit depends on calibration quality and inference cost.   This paper develops a unified statistical framework for both evaluation routes under alternative sampling strategies. For direct auditing, confidence-stratified sampling is used to recover population accuracy from partially verified outputs without requiring calibrated confidence. Finite-sample uncertainty is characterized, and the analysis shows how highly uneven confidence strata affect audit efficiency and label allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, the judge is modeled through sensitivity and false-positive rate, yielding an error-corrected estimator with calibration uncertainty. The two routes are then compared through human-label and total-cost efficiency boundaries.   Experiments on MMLU-Pro and MMMU-Pro show that miscalibrated self-confidence can still support statistically valid stratified auditing. Under highly imbalanced confidence distributions, proportional allocation substantially reduces estimation error relative to equal-per-stratum allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, only a small subset of target--verifier pairs satisfies the idealized human-label efficiency condition, and automated inference costs can further limit potential savings. These findings clarify the statistical and economic conditions under which confidence-guided auditing and automated verification are useful.

ai_summary.problem: LLM/MLLM 自报置信度常校准不佳，而直接人工审计成本高、LLM-as-a-judge 又受校准质量和推理成本限制，论文要解决如何在这两种评估路径下进行可扩展且统计有效的人类在环评估。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出统一统计框架：直接审计采用置信度分层抽样，在无需置信度校准的情况下从部分验证输出恢复总体准确率并刻画有限样本不确定性；LLM 辅助评估将 judge 建模为敏感度和假阳性率，得到带校准不确定性的误差校正估计，并通过人工标签与总成本效率边界比较两条路径。
ai_summary.result: MMLU-Pro 和 MMMU-Pro 实验表明，即使自置信度校准不佳仍可支持统计有效的分层审计；在置信度分布高度不平衡时，按比例分配显著优于每层等量分配。judge 辅助评估中只有少量目标-验证器对满足理想人工标签效率条件，自动推理成本还会进一步限制节省空间。
ai_summary.novelty: 将置信度分层人工审计与 LLM judge 误差校正评估纳入统一统计框架，并同时从标签效率和总成本边界分析其适用条件。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 LLM/MLLM 评测中如何低成本、统计可靠地结合人工审计与自动 judge 提供了方法论依据。

papers.title: From Language to Drives: A Multimodal Framework for Aligning Autonomous Robots with Human Purposes
papers.abstract: This work explores a multimodal approach to the alignment of the behavior of open-ended learning autonomous robots with human purposes through the use of large language models as cultural enablers. While autonomous robots can generate their own skills and goals through interaction with the environment, they often lack mechanisms to ensure that these remain relevant and aligned to those of human users. The proposed approach makes use of the general and cultural knowledge contained in LLMs and VLMs to establish a multimodal interactive alignment process in which human purposes, expressed in natural language, are transformed into motivational components of a robot architecture in the form of robot missions and drives that guide the behavior of the robot. The system is structured into three layers for semantic alignment, mission generation, and drive modeling. This design enables a bidirectional interaction loop: human inputs define high-level purposes, robots expand them into executable missions making use of multimodal information relayed by LLMs and VLMs, and feedback maintains alignment with human intent. Experiments in simulation and with a physical robot demonstrate that the process produces valid missions and behaviors, supporting effective human-agent alignment in interactive scenarios with autonomous robots.

ai_summary.problem: 开放式自主学习机器人能自行生成技能和目标，但缺乏确保其行为与人类目的保持一致并对齐的机制。
ai_summary.method: 利用LLM和VLM中的通用与文化知识，构建多模态交互对齐流程，将自然语言表达的人类目的转化为机器人架构中的任务（missions）和驱力（drives）；系统分为语义对齐、任务生成和驱力建模三层，并形成双向交互反馈环路。
ai_summary.result: 仿真和实体机器人实验表明，该方法能生成有效任务和行为，在交互场景中支持人-智能体有效对齐。
ai_summary.novelty: 将LLM/VLM作为文化使能器，把人类自然语言目的转化为开放式学习机器人的任务与驱力，实现多层多模态的人机目的对齐。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能和自主机器人中的人机对齐、LLM驱动的任务生成与行为控制提供了可交互的框架。

papers.title: Robot-Aligned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Precise Reaching with Wrist-Camera VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Efficient robotic data collection remains a major bottleneck for vision-language-action (VLA) policy learning, especially for tasks requiring accurate end-effector positioning and camera-action alignment. This challenge is particularly severe in electronic-waste disassembly, where robots operate in cluttered assemblies of densely packed, visually similar components. Full digital-twin simulation is difficult because many parts are thin, reflective, or mechanically complex, making accurate object-level meshes and contact models difficult to obtain. In this work, we focus on pre-contact reaching and propose a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based data generation pipeline for wrist-camera VLA adaptation. Our method reconstructs the real workspace with 3DGS and renders diverse wrist-camera observations from robot-aligned poses. These observations are paired with smooth, structured reaching trajectories to provide robot-aligned visual-action supervision for VLA fine-tuning. We further augment the VLA policy with an instruction-conditioned reach verifier that estimates target proximity and provides reliable termination before physical interaction. Experiments in motherboard disassembly demonstrate precise VLA-based reaching using wrist-camera observations alone, without an external side-view camera. With $π$0.5, 1,500 generated trajectories achieve 80.0\% precise-reaching success across three targets, compared with 58.7\% using 150 teleoperated demonstrations, while requiring less than 10 minutes of active human capture. Project website: https://001-wang.github.io/PrecisionReach-GS/

ai_summary.problem: 该论文旨在解决腕部相机VLA策略在电子废弃物拆解等精细操作场景中，因真实机器人数据采集成本高、部件密集相似且难以构建精确数字孪生而导致的预接触精准到达数据不足问题。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出基于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的数据生成流水线，重建真实工作空间并从机器人对齐位姿渲染多样腕部相机观测，与平滑结构化到达轨迹配对用于VLA微调；同时增加指令条件化的到达验证器，在物理交互前估计目标接近程度并可靠终止。
ai_summary.result: 在主板拆解实验中，仅使用腕部相机观测即可实现精准到达；基于π0.5，1,500条生成轨迹在三个目标上达到80.0%的精准到达成功率，高于150条遥操作演示的58.7%，且主动人类采集时间少于10分钟。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新在于用机器人对齐的3DGS渲染数据为腕部相机VLA提供视觉-动作监督，并引入指令条件化到达验证器实现交互前可靠终止。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作展示了3DGS合成数据在降低VLA真实数据采集成本、提升精细操作策略泛化与精度方面的潜力，对具身智能数据生成与腕部相机策略学习有参考价值。

papers.title: ArchiveLens: A Generative Spatial Knowledge Framework for Semantic Reconstruction of Historical Maps
papers.abstract: Historical maps contain dense morphological and semantic information about past urban environments, but many digitization workflows focus primarily on extracting geometry, and do not capture cartographic semantics such as building use and construction materials. This study introduces ArchiveLens, a generative spatial knowledge framework that operationalizes historical maps as entity-centric, machine-queryable geospatial databases. The pipeline decouples morphological and semantic reconstruction through three stages: tiled YOLOv11-seg instance segmentation for building footprint extraction; deterministic material classification via hue, saturation, and value (HSV)-based color thresholds; and localized attribute parsing using a quantized vision-language model constrained by domain-specific prompts. Extracted entities are integrated into a hybrid Spatial-Temporal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (ST-RAG) architecture that combines dense semantic retrieval with symbolic spatio-temporal filtering and mandatory provenance grounding. Applied to 445 georeferenced Sanborn map sheets of Chicago (1918-1950), the framework achieves high geometric and semantic accuracy. Beyond performance, ArchiveLens advances GIScience by formalizing historical cartography as structured spatial knowledge representation, allowing researchers to query building attributes and compare spatial patterns across map sheets and years.

ai_summary.problem: 历史地图数字化流程通常偏重几何提取，未充分捕获建筑用途、建筑材料等制图语义，导致历史地图难以作为可机器查询和跨图比较的空间知识库使用。
ai_summary.method: 提出 ArchiveLens 生成式空间知识框架，将形态与语义重建解耦为三阶段：分块 YOLOv11-seg 提取建筑轮廓；基于 HSV 颜色阈值的确定性材料分类；在领域提示约束下用量化视觉语言模型进行局部属性解析。提取实体被集成到混合 ST-RAG 架构中，结合稠密语义检索、符号化时空过滤和强制溯源依据。
ai_summary.result: 在芝加哥 1918—1950 年 445 幅地理配准 Sanborn 地图上取得较高的几何与语义精度，并支持查询建筑属性、比较不同图幅和年份间的空间模式。
ai_summary.novelty: 将历史地图形式化为以实体为中心、可机器查询的时空知识库，并通过带溯源约束的 ST-RAG 整合多模态提取结果。
ai_summary.relevance: 对多模态文档理解、空间知识表示以及检索增强生成在 GIScience 中的应用具有参考价值。
ai_summary.org: 未提供

papers.title: Explainable Multimodal AI Approach to Reduce Unnecessary Breast Biopsies
papers.abstract: Recently, there has been rise in multimodal vision-language models for computer-aided diagnosis (CAD), yet their application in breast diagnosis, particularly for predicting biopsy outcomes remains limited. This study presents a multimodal vision-language approach, incorporating Grad-CAM as an Explainable AI (XAI) technique, to predict benign tumors in patients recommended for biopsy, especially those classified as BI-RADS 4 and 5. A novel multimodal framework was devel- oped using Vision Transformer (ViT) for imaging feature extraction and DeBERTa-V3-Large for textual embeddings. The model was trained and evaluated on a comprehensive in-house dataset comprising 1,632 patients, each with four mammography views and a corresponding radiology report. The features of both modalities were extracted independently and fused by late fusion before classification. Grad-CAM was used to generate visual explanations highlighting key regions influencing model predictions. The proposed model demonstrated high sensitivity 90%, 95%, 99%, and 100% with corresponding specificities of 40%, 36%, 18%, and 11%, respectively. The best AUC achieved was 0.72 by multimodal approach on the test set, outperforming the image only (0.66) and text-only (0.68) baselines. The proposed multimodal architecture, enhanced with Grad-CAM, demonstrates a strong potential to identify benign tumors among high-risk patients, offering interpretable insights and thereby helping reduce unnecessary biopsies, patient anxiety, and healthcare costs.

ai_summary.problem: 该论文旨在利用多模态视觉-语言模型预测BI-RADS 4和5高风险患者中的良性肿瘤，从而减少不必要的乳腺活检。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出一个多模态框架：用Vision Transformer提取乳腺影像特征，用DeBERTa-V3-Large提取放射报告文本特征，独立提取后通过晚期融合进行分类，并用Grad-CAM生成可解释的视觉热图。模型在包含1,632名患者、每人四视图乳腺X线影像及对应报告的内部数据集上训练和评估。
ai_summary.result: 多模态模型在测试集上取得最佳AUC 0.72，优于仅影像的0.66和仅文本的0.68；在90%、95%、99%和100%灵敏度下，特异性分别为40%、36%、18%和11%。结果表明其有潜力识别高风险患者中的良性肿瘤并提供可解释依据，但高灵敏度伴随较低特异性。
ai_summary.novelty: 将乳腺X线影像与放射报告通过晚期融合结合，并引入Grad-CAM可解释性，用于BI-RADS 4/5患者的良性病变预测以减少不必要活检。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了多模态可解释CAD在乳腺诊断中的应用潜力，但其AUC和特异性仍有限，说明该方向值得关注但尚需更大验证。

papers.title: TrySee: Modular Perception-Enhanced VLM Grounding for Closed-Loop Robot Task Planning in Specialized Domains
papers.abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown impressive capabilities in high-level reasoning and task planning for robots. However, specialized domains remain a challenge for VLMs' image interpretation and grounding abilities. We introduce TrySee, a modular closed-loop robot task planning pipeline integrating general-purpose VLM reasoning with domain-specific perception and established robotics components. The system consists of an inherently reactive cyclic planning pipeline, augmented with domain-specific modular vision preprocessing, to provide online grounding. Finally, a dynamic preprocessing selection mechanism contributes to the scalability of the pipeline. The system requires neither VLM fine-tuning nor end-to-end demonstrations and adapts through replaceable perception modules and motion planning. The approach is evaluated on planning tasks across 5 widely different domains, including a real-world robot disassembly task. The field tests in a brownfield environment demonstrate the approach's practicality in integrating VLM planning into specialized robotic systems with limited domain-specific training data.

ai_summary.problem: 通用VLM在专业领域（如工业拆解等）的图像理解与grounding能力不足，且难以获取领域训练数据，导致高层推理无法可靠落地到机器人任务规划。
ai_summary.method: 提出TrySee，将通用VLM推理与领域专用感知模块、成熟机器人组件组合成反应式闭环规划管线；通过模块化视觉预处理提供在线grounding，并用动态预处理选择机制提升可扩展性，无需VLM微调或端到端示教。
ai_summary.result: 在5个差异较大的领域的规划任务以及真实机器人拆解任务上完成评估，实地测试表明该方法能在领域数据有限的专用机器人系统中实用地集成VLM规划。
ai_summary.novelty: 以可替换的模块化感知预处理+动态选择机制，在不微调VLM的前提下实现专业领域的闭环grounding与规划。
ai_summary.relevance: 为VLM在专业机器人与具身智能场景中的低成本、可扩展落地提供了模块化工程范式。

papers.title: EARS: Evidence-Aware Retrieval via Sound and Motion for Budgeted Video Reasoning
papers.abstract: Uniform frame sampling can miss brief evidence in sparse-event videos when the VLM sees only K frames. We propose EARS (Evidence-Aware Retrieval via Sound and motion), a training-free, query-free front-end that ranks frames using optical-flow motion and audio energy, then applies temporal non-maximum suppression for diversity. The evidence score alone has frame-level AP 0.39; used only to select frames for the VLM, EARS with temporal diversity reaches localization AP 0.94, compared with 0.88 under Uniform sampling. In the updated matched study, at K = 1 EARS reaches XD-subset F1 0.660 versus 0.614 for centered Uniform (the paired interval includes zero); earlier backbone studies use separate protocols. On mostly-silent UCF-Crime, however, EARS slightly trails Uniform. A single configuration is used across both benchmarks; the new controls do not repeat the original held-out search. EARS therefore targets low-budget videos whose salient evidence aligns with motion or audio; on dense narratives or stealthy events, uniform or semantic selection remains preferable, and cheap modality statistics cannot reliably route between them. Code: https://github.com/mikeslin-ir/EARS

ai_summary.problem: 在只能让VLM看K帧的低预算视频推理中，均匀采样容易漏掉稀疏事件视频中的短暂关键证据。
ai_summary.method: 提出EARS，一种无需训练、无需查询的前端：利用光流运动能量和音频能量对帧打分，再用时序非极大值抑制保证多样性，最后选出帧交给VLM。
ai_summary.result: 仅证据分数在帧级AP为0.39；结合时序多样性选帧后定位AP达0.94，高于均匀采样的0.88。K=1时XD-subset F1为0.660，对比居中均匀采样的0.614，但配对区间包含零；在多数静音的UCF-Crime上略逊于均匀采样。
ai_summary.novelty: 用运动与音频两种廉价模态做无需训练、无需查询的帧检索，并加入时序多样性抑制。
ai_summary.relevance: 为低预算视频推理提供了一种轻量选帧前端，但主要适用于显著证据与运动或声音对齐的视频，密集叙事或隐蔽事件仍需均匀或语义选择。

papers.title: Multimodal Concert Video Editing: System Design and Exploratory Evaluation
papers.abstract: Editing multi-camera concerts requires coordinated decisions about musical relevance, visual quality and cut timing. We present a modular framework that combines instrument activity from multitrack audio, visible instruments and image sharpness with beat-based timing and probabilistic camera selection. An interpretable scoring model links these components to the choice of views over complete shot intervals. Component tests and an exploratory expert study on a four-camera concert yield mixed assessments across the editing variants. The findings motivate extending local audiovisual relevance with contextual and sequence-level criteria. The architecture provides a basis for testing these extensions and studying how component behaviour affects the quality of complete edits.

ai_summary.problem: 多机位音乐会视频编辑需要同时权衡音乐相关性、画面质量和剪辑时机，现有方法难以系统化地协调这些因素。
ai_summary.method: 提出一个模块化框架，融合多轨音频中的乐器活动、可见乐器和图像清晰度，并结合基于节拍的时序与概率化镜头选择；用可解释评分模型在完整镜头区间上选择视角。
ai_summary.result: 组件测试和四机位音乐会的探索性专家研究给出了混合评价，说明仅靠局部视听相关性不足，需要引入上下文和序列级标准。
ai_summary.novelty: 将多模态视听分析与节拍驱动剪辑、可解释镜头评分结合，用于完整镜头区间的多机位音乐会自动编辑。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态视频理解与生成、媒体制作自动化提供了可测试的系统框架，但偏应用探索，AI方法创新有限。

key_lab_papers.title: VibeVideoBench:Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
key_lab_papers.abstract: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a ruleconsistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events. A different route is emerging: multimodal agents that write code to render every frame and synthesize every sound. We introduce VibeVideoBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on code-driven video generation. Its 239 self-contained tasks in English and Chinese span 12 categories, from data stories and music-driven pieces to classroom lessons and paper explainers; each asks an agent, running in its native harness inside a sandbox, to deliver a finished MP4 with sound within one hour. Evaluation is hierarchical and evidence-based: program checks of the delivery spec, about 13k task-specific rubric checks traced to the requirements they enforce, and five quality dimensions anchored per task, judged by three VLM judge panels and validated with blind human preferences. Across nine frontier agent systems and 2,151 scored rollouts, the benchmark is far from solved: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead clearly, yet even the best system fails a core requirement on about a quarter of tasks. Whether a video arrives at all matters as much as its quality, and three quarters of the lost videos are final renders started too late, run too slowly or never started. The judges agree with each other and with human preferences on system rankings, but only moderately on individual videos.

ai_summary.problem: 扩散视频模型难以精确呈现公式、图表、规则一致的游戏或与画面同步的旁白，因此需要评估能够通过编写代码逐帧渲染视频并合成声音的多模态智能体。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 VibeVideoBench，包含 239 个中英文自包含任务、覆盖 12 类场景，要求智能体在沙箱原生环境中于一小时内交付带声音的 MP4。评测采用分层、证据驱动方式：程序检查交付规范、约 1.3 万条可追溯到任务需求的具体评分项，以及由三个 VLM 评审面板按五个质量维度评分，并用盲测人类偏好验证。
ai_summary.result: 在九个前沿智能体系统和 2151 次评分运行中，基准仍远未解决：GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5.5 明显领先，但最佳系统仍在约四分之一任务上失败核心要求；视频能否成功交付与质量同样重要，四分之三的丢失视频源于最终渲染启动过晚、运行过慢或从未启动。评审间及与人类偏好在系统排名上较一致，但对单个视频仅中等一致。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出了面向代码驱动视频生成的多模态智能体基准，并结合可追溯评分项、VLM 评审面板与人类偏好验证进行分层评测。
ai_summary.relevance: 为评估多模态智能体在长程代码生成、执行调度与视频交付可靠性方面提供了新基准，揭示了当前前沿系统在真实端到端创作任务中的关键瓶颈。

daily_insight.hot_topics: 多模态研究占据今日绝对主导（20 篇中 18 篇），并明显向具身智能与机器人方向迁移：VLA、3DGS 监督、仿真 RL 与预训练 VLM 解耦、闭环 grounding 规划等多条路线同时出现。同时，面向智能体的评测基准成为新的重点，覆盖代码驱动视频生成（VibeVideoBench）、前沿 Agent 能力边界刻画以及细粒度信用分配。世界模型虽仅 2 篇，但分别指向推理侧适配目标与长时程记忆系统化，显示出从“能预测”向“可用于规划”演进的迹象。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日大厂论文仅有 Anthropic 1 篇（VibeVideoBench，代码驱动视频生成的多模态 Agent 基准），没有其他大厂在相同或相近方向布局，因此不存在方法层面的竞争或互补关系。该方向在今日数据中属于 Anthropic 单独占位，其余论文主要来自学术机构或未标注组织，整体呈现“大厂缺席、学界密集铺开”的格局。
daily_insight.signals: 1）多模态主题占比高达 90%，且其中过半与机器人、具身场景绑定，说明多模态研究的关注点正从理解/生成转向以行动为中心的具身落地；2）评测与基准类论文（VibeVideoBench、EBench、HITL 评估统计框架）集中出现，反映 Agent 能力评测正从单一能力打分转向过程性、统计上可校正的评估；3）世界模型的两篇分别处理测试时适应的目标函数（把规划代价纳入）与 KV 记忆的 NVMe 分层，指向部署侧的效率与任务对齐瓶颈；4）医学视觉 tokenizer 追求跨维度跨模态通用化，是垂直领域基础设施化的信号。
